scope: Read-only reconciliation of the valid previewed persisted project proposal session exposed by M527

sourceReread.selfTestSessionSuppression: Any project self-test mode leaves the React projectProposalSession unloaded until explicit review, so projectProposalSession === null is expected during this route.
sourceReread.redactedPreflight: M527 reports PASS:previewed from the typed exact-key loader and the route blocks before lifecycle without exposing raw session data or clearing it.
sourceReread.terminalClearContract: A valid session may be cleared only after its history status is terminal; previewed is nonterminal and cannot be silently cleared.

m527Evidence.meaning: The exact project key contains a valid proposal session whose history currently ends at previewed; this does not establish self-test origin, exact command, exact fixture binding, or safe recovery.

ownershipReconciliation.conclusion: PASS:previewed is sufficient to identify valid nonterminal state, but not sufficient to authorize mutation or claim exact test ownership.

workerReview.recommendation: Add one pure code-only ownership classifier that emits only redacted categorical/boolean results; do not expose storage key, IDs, actors, timestamps, hashes, payload, validation reason, or raw session.

validation.nextBoundary: M529 code-only redacted ownership classifier comparing the validated session to the deterministic broken-reference fixture; emit TEST_OWNED_EXACT or OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN and no mutation
